items.title: Alphonse Picou Interview, 1958-04-04
items.q: The first woman that sang the blues. Ma Rainey? What? Ma Rainey? No.

ctx.x: Do you have any... Do you remember... When was the first time that you can remember that people were using the word jazz?

Yeah. Jazz can be... When... Let me see the great... The first woman that sang the blues. Ma Rainey? What? Ma Rainey? No. First woman that sang the blues to the television. To the television? Yeah. Oh.
